name: InitCameraModule
evidence: the camera file's entry in g_startupInitializers (D_002647C0[13]); its body is empty

name: ComputeOffsetBehindTarget
evidence: calls ComputePolarOffset with the target's heading at 0x30 plus pi and its pitch at 0x34, writing the offset behind it (func_00143208, func_001433E0 and func_00143418 call it)

name: SpringCameraVector
evidence: moves a 16-byte position toward a goal through a velocity with the three spring factors it is given, or copies the goal and zeroes the velocity when the snap flag at 0x224 is set (func_00143208 and func_00145718 call it)

name: UpdateCameraTargetTracking
evidence: the step UpdateCamera runs for the target in action: ComputeOffsetBehindTarget, then SpringCameraVector on the offset at 0x250 (velocity 0x260) and the vector at 0x270 (velocity 0x280), with factors chosen by the mode at 0x268C when the target is D_00262E10

name: ResetCameraTargetTracking
evidence: UpdateCamera calls it when the target changes: ComputeOffsetBehindTarget into 0x250 and zeroes the velocities at 0x260, 0x270 and 0x280

name: ComputeCameraFogTerms
evidence: fits a reciprocal through (1, 4080) and (far/near, (1 - strength) * 4080) from the fog settings at 0x1F8/0x1FC/0x200 and writes the four terms (with the 2^23 bias) UpdateCameraProjection stores at 0x208

name: UpdateCameraProjection
evidence: derives from the zoom at 0x1C4, the settings at 0x1E0 and the near and far distances at 0x1E4/0x1E8 the values at 0x1F0..0x1EC, builds the matrix at 0xC0 with func_00189F58 and calls func_001434C8 and func_00144540; every setter below calls it

name: InitCamera
evidence: slot 0 of the 0x6D class: runs the base set-up, stores the zoom, near/far and projection settings at 0x1C0..0x208, copies the frame at 0x80, installs the five controller tables and calls ResetCamera

name: SnapCurrentCameraZoom
evidence: calls SnapCameraZoom on g_camera with the float it is given

name: SetCurrentCameraNearDistance
evidence: calls SetCameraNearDistance on g_camera with the float it is given

name: SetCurrentCameraFarDistance
evidence: calls SetCameraFarDistance on g_camera with the float it is given

name: SetCurrentCameraFogNear
evidence: calls SetCameraFogNear on g_camera with the float it is given

name: SetCurrentCameraFogFar
evidence: calls SetCameraFogFar on g_camera with the float it is given

name: SetCurrentCameraFogStrength
evidence: calls SetCameraFogStrength on g_camera with the float it is given

name: SetCurrentCameraFogColor
evidence: calls SetCameraFogColor on g_camera with the colour it is given

name: SetCurrentCameraDistanceScale
evidence: calls SetCameraDistanceScale on g_camera with the float it is given

name: SetCameraPosition
evidence: calls SetCameraPlacement with only the position argument (the 16 bytes copied to 0x40)

name: SetCameraOrientation
evidence: calls SetCameraPlacement with only the second argument (the three 16-byte rows copied to 0x80, 0x90, 0xA0)

name: SnapCameraZoom
evidence: stores its argument as both the zoom at 0x1C4 and the target zoom at 0x1C8, zeroes the rate at 0x1CC and calls UpdateCameraProjection (UpdateCamera calls it to jump to the target)

name: SetCameraNearDistance
evidence: stores the value at 0x1E4 (default 100, passed to the projection builder before the 20000 at 0x1E8) and updates the projection

name: SetCameraFarDistance
evidence: stores the value at 0x1E8 (default 20000, the last argument of the projection builder in UpdateCameraProjection) and updates the projection

name: SetCameraFogNear
evidence: stores the value at 0x1F8 (default 500, the near term of ComputeCameraFogTerms) and updates the projection

name: SetCameraFogFar
evidence: stores the value at 0x1FC (default 20000, the far term of ComputeCameraFogTerms) and updates the projection

name: SetCameraFogStrength
evidence: stores the value at 0x200 (default 0.5, how far ComputeCameraFogTerms lowers the far value) and updates the projection

name: SetCameraFogColor
evidence: copies the 32-bit colour at 0x204 (default 0x80303030) and updates the projection

name: SetCameraDistanceScale
evidence: stores the value at 0x1C0, which UpdateCameraProjection divides by the zoom into the scale at 0xB0 that ComputeCameraDistanceFade multiplies distances by, then updates g_camera's projection

name: ResetCamera
evidence: optionally places the camera from D_00261880/D_00261890, then empties the controller stack (count 0x3D0 = 0), pushes controller ctl454 with func_00145088, clears the pending snap and sets 0x218/0x21C

name: ClearCameraObjectList
evidence: sets the count at 0x340 of the object pointer list at 0x344 to 0

name: AddCameraObject
evidence: appends the item to the pointer list at 0x344 when the count at 0x340 is below 8

name: RemoveCameraObject
evidence: finds the value in the list at 0x344, shifts the later entries down with func_0018D800 and decrements the count at 0x340

name: IsCameraObstacle
evidence: the filter func_00143BE0 passes to func_001DC238 around the camera: accepts an object whose bits 32..35 of the 64-bit flags at 0x538 are 1 or whose 0x404 is set

name: UpdateCamera
evidence: runs the top controller on the frame time (calls the target's slot 0x124/4, the controller's slot 4) and eases the zoom at 0x1C4 toward 0x1C8 with func_001EA620, updating the projection

name: UnprojectCameraPoint
evidence: turns a point given in the camera's screen terms (x and y scaled by the depth and by the factors at 0x1F0/0x1F4) into a world point through the rows at 0x80 and the position at 0x40

name: ProjectPointToCamera
evidence: the inverse of UnprojectCameraPoint: brings a world point into the frame at 0x40/0x80 and divides x and y by the factors at 0x1F0/0x1F4 and by the depth

name: UpdateCameraLocation
evidence: recomputes the camera's derived rows (func_00144008), then finds the leaf of the world's tree at 0x1EC4 holding the position at 0x40 (func_001EEBB0) and keeps it at 0x21C; RunMainLoop and LoadWorld call it

name: BuildViewProjectionMatrix
evidence: builds a 4x4 matrix from a 3x3 frame (columns reordered and negated) and a position, inverts it and multiplies the projection it is given by the inverse; UpdateCameraMatrices, RefreshConeVolumeShape and BuildRangeRecordPacket call it

name: UpdateCameraMatrices
evidence: rebuilds the camera's matrices from its frame, near/far at 0x1E4/0x1E8 and factors at 0x1F0/0x1F4 (BuildViewProjectionMatrix, func_00189F58, func_001443C8); every placement and projection change calls it

name: WriteCameraMatricesPacket
evidence: writes the 4 quadwords at 0x100 and the 8 at 0x140 into a DMA tag of g_vifPacketWriter; UploadCameraOncePerFrame and PrepareUnzoomedGroup call it

name: SetCameraPlacement
evidence: copies a 16-byte position to 0x40 and three 16-byte rows to 0x80/0x90/0xA0 when given, calls func_00144540 and zeroes the five floats at 0x2B0..0x2C0

name: PlaceCameraLookingAt
evidence: calls func_00144BE8 with a position and a point to look at and no offsets; ResetCamera places the camera at (0, -2000, 500) looking at the origin with it

name: ComputeLookFrameCoordinates
evidence: builds the frame from one point toward another (func_00189350) and writes a third point's coordinates in it, divided by the distance (at least 100), through three float pointers; the inverse of ApplyLookFrameCoordinates

name: ApplyLookFrameCoordinates
evidence: builds the frame from one point toward another (func_00189350) and writes the point given by three coordinates in it, scaled by the distance

name: SetCameraLookAnchor
evidence: turns the coordinates at 0x2B0..0x2B8 back into a point from the old anchor at 0x2D0, re-expresses it from the new anchor and stores the new anchor at 0x2D0

name: ComputeCameraRelativeStickHeading
evidence: returns, wrapped, the heading of a pad record's left (0x40/0x44, mode 0) or right (0x74/0x78, mode 1) stick plus the camera's heading from its frame at 0x80; the collider and walker input code calls it

name: PushCameraController
evidence: pushes a controller onto the camera's stack at 0x3D4 (count 0x3D0), ordered by key; the stack is walked by UpdateCamera and cleaned by RemoveCameraControllers

name: RemoveCameraControllers
evidence: drops the stack entries matching the key, controller, target and argument selected by the flag bits, calls their slot 3, then slot 1 on the old top and slot 0 on the new top

name: ComputeCameraDistanceFade
evidence: compares an offset's length with a radius plus a distance scaled by the camera's 0xB0 and writes a fade from 1 down over the last 400 units; returns 0 beyond it (DrawEffectAt, DrawTrailSegment, IsSphereInCameraView call it)

name: ConvertOffsetToCylindrical
evidence: from a vector (or the difference of two) writes its heading (func_00205778, wrapped by func_001EA408), its horizontal length and its height, each when its pointer is given

name: ConvertOffsetToSpherical
evidence: from a vector (or the difference of two) writes its heading, its pitch above the horizontal and its length, each when its pointer is given

name: RequestCameraSnap
evidence: sets the snap flag at 0x224 (UpdateCamera then jumps the zoom) and, given a value, the flag at 0x228 and the value at 0x22C

name: QueueCameraSnap
evidence: sets the flag at 0x220, which UpdateCamera turns into the snap flag at 0x224 at its next run

name: RequestPlainCameraSnap
evidence: calls RequestCameraSnap with no value

name: FindFirstFreeSpan
evidence: collects spans of every object with func_0013DFD8, merges them with MergeOverlappingSpans, and returns the first gap in [0,1] wider than thresh through lo/hi

name: HasColliderSecondTree
evidence: the filter func_00145E68 and FindFreeOnOffCameraScreenSpan pass to the object gathering: accepts an object whose second mesh's tree (0x530) has nodes

name: PushCameraStackValue
evidence: calls PushStackValue on the camera's controller at 0x460

name: PopCameraStackValue
evidence: returns PopStackValue of the camera's controller at 0x460

name: PeekCameraStackValue
evidence: returns PeekStackValue of the camera's controller at 0x460

name: RecordCameraTimestamp
evidence: stores g_gameTime at 0x218 (ResetCamera sets it to -10; UpdateCameraMatrices reads it)

name: IsSphereInCameraView
evidence: tests a point with a radius against the three planes at 0x50..0x70 around the position at 0x40 and, when inside, returns whether ComputeCameraDistanceFade accepts it
